governing_rule: No proposed option becomes active until the owner records explicit approval in a subsequent versioned approval artifact.

decision_groups.title: Direct-history calibrated method
decision_groups.standard_boundary: The standard authorizes the route and required outputs but does not define the equation.
decision_groups.prior_reference: scripts/build_tier_1_forward_scenarios.py contains a dated cross-lane scenario method and is not authoritative.

options.label: Robust historical CAGR blend
options.description: Use multiple governed historical return windows with recency and data-quality weighting, then convert the approved annual rate to 1/3/5-year scenarios.

options.label: Trend plus mean-reversion blend
options.description: Combine recent momentum with long-run return and drawdown-to-history relationships.

options.label: Owner-defined alternative
options.description: Use a different explicitly approved equation.

decision_groups.recommendation_reason: It is interpretable, backtestable, and directly tied to governed historical evidence without inheriting unsupported legacy anchors.

decision_groups.title: Direct-history limited method
decision_groups.standard_boundary: The standard requires reduced confidence and wider uncertainty but does not define the numeric method.

options.label: History-comparable blend
options.description: Use limited direct history only as a minority input and rely primarily on approved comparables.

options.label: Comparable-only until mature
options.description: Do not use limited direct history numerically until the product qualifies for calibrated history.

options.label: Owner-defined alternative
options.description: Use a different explicitly approved treatment.

decision_groups.recommendation_reason: It preserves real product evidence while preventing a short series from dominating the result.

decision_groups.title: Comparable-product adjusted method
decision_groups.standard_boundary: Comparables and disclosures are required, but aggregation and weighting equations are undefined.

options.label: Similarity-weighted peer returns
options.description: Weight peer forward return profiles by governed comparable similarity and peer history quality.

options.label: Median peer return
options.description: Use the median of selected peer return profiles with no score weighting.

options.label: Owner-defined alternative
options.description: Use a different explicitly approved aggregation method.

decision_groups.recommendation_reason: It uses the already-governed comparable scores and preserves explainability through explicit peer contributions.

decision_groups.title: Fundamental-comparable hybrid method
decision_groups.standard_boundary: The Japanese FINAL FANTASY hybrid route is approved, but its numerical comparable and fundamental weights are undefined.

options.label: Comparable-majority hybrid
options.description: Use the approved same-set comparable as the primary input and a minority fundamental adjustment.

options.label: Equal-weight hybrid
options.description: Use equal comparable and fundamental contributions.

options.label: Owner-defined alternative
options.description: Use different explicitly approved weights.

decision_groups.recommendation_reason: The approved override identifies a primary comparable, so the comparable should remain the dominant evidence source.

decision_groups.title: Scenarios, confidence, and uncertainty
decision_groups.standard_boundary: The standard requires downside/base/upside, confidence, and uncertainty disclosures but does not define formulas or classes.

options.label: Evidence-derived intervals
options.description: Build scenario width from historical dispersion, peer dispersion, evidence quality, and method limitations; derive confidence from evidence completeness and agreement.

options.label: Fixed scenario bands
options.description: Use owner-approved fixed percentage bands by method class.

options.label: Owner-defined alternative
options.description: Use another explicitly approved framework.

decision_groups.recommendation_reason: It satisfies the standard principle that confidence and uncertainty reflect the evidence actually used.

decision_groups.title: Supply, demand, liquidity, and reprint adjustments
decision_groups.standard_boundary: These factors are required evidence, but their forecast adjustment equations are undefined.

options.label: Bounded transparent adjustment
options.description: Convert governed factor deviations from neutral into a disclosed bounded adjustment applied after the core method estimate.

options.label: Evidence-only disclosure
options.description: Use these factors for confidence and limitations only, not to alter forecast values.

options.label: Owner-defined alternative
options.description: Use another explicitly approved adjustment design.

decision_groups.recommendation_reason: It makes the required factors economically meaningful while keeping their effect visible and constrained.

decision_groups.title: Caps, freshness thresholds, and purchase analysis
decision_groups.standard_boundary: The standard requires fail-closed current price and separate purchase authorization, but numeric limits and purchase equations are undefined.

options.label: Data-derived review gates
options.description: Use diagnostics and backtesting to propose numerical thresholds; keep all recommendations unauthorized until those thresholds are separately approved.

options.label: No numeric gates yet
options.description: Generate forecasts with disclosures only and defer purchase analysis entirely.

options.label: Owner-defined thresholds
options.description: Use explicit owner-specified limits and purchase rules.

decision_groups.recommendation_reason: It allows evidence-based threshold design without silently inheriting legacy values or prematurely authorizing purchases.
